svg.aria-label: Definition 2.8: the last byte p of the plaintext is checked by the length test and the byte test. If both pass, strip removes the tag and p plus one padding bytes; otherwise strip zero removes only the last t bytes as the tag.
svg.text: Definition 2.8: the padding predicate Πstrict​ and the two ways of stripping
Example: a decrypted plaintext P of ℓP​ = 64 bytes (four 16-byte blocks), tag length t = 20

svg.text: the last t bytes are read as the tag; nothing else is stripped
Φ₁.₁ applies strip when Πstrict​(P) holds and strip₀ otherwise. strip₀ is the RFC’s “assume a zero-length pad”.
The two branches hand the MAC records of different lengths r, which is the leakage λ₁.₁ = h + r of Definition 2.11.
